title: Rapid Golem Oxidation
description: Accelerates the aging process for Copper Golems using Splash Water Potions. Allows players to bypass the standard 30-hour wait time and fully oxidize a golem in under a minute using three potions.
body:
📢 **Rapid Golem Oxidation** 🤖

Nobody has time to wait 30 real-life hours for a Copper Golem to rust. I fixed it.

💧 **The Fix:** Use Splash Water Potions on your Golems.
⏱️ **The Speed:** 3 bottles = Near-statue state in <60 seconds.
🧱 **The Scope:** Golems ONLY. Your copper walls are safe.
